keyNotes: Written on the sheets: the main block 28'-0" by 34'-0", the shed 11'-1 1/2" by 8'-5 1/2", the lanai 6'-0" and 16'-0", each room's nominal size, floor to plate 9'-0", floor to ridge 14'-0", front steps to ridge 18'-4". Everything else measured off the 8-bit TIFF at 149.5 pixels a foot (3/8" = 1'-0"; the scale checked against the 28'-0" and 34'-0" strings to within 0.5%).

The walls are single board walls (1x6 tongue and groove on studs only at openings), about 0.1 ft thick, so the room outlines nearly touch. Outlines are the clear floor; built-in shelves are left out (the kitchen's 1 ft shelf strip on its north-west side, the bathroom's shelf on its south-east side, the shelves between the two closets).

The rooms' written sizes are nominal: measured clear sizes are kitchen 7.35 by 14.65 (16' with the shelf), living room 15.6 by 20.1 (the plan's 16' x 18' is the part beside the bedrooms), bedrooms 11.85 by 11.05 and 11.85 by 11.45, bathroom 7.3 by 10.25, lanai 15.6 by 5.4.

The ceiling is flat at the plate, 9'-0" over the floor, in every room and over the lanai (sections A-A and B-B). The house stands on posts: the floor is 4'-4" over the front slab and about 3.9 ft over the shed's concrete floor (measured off the west elevation). The shed's roof slopes from about 7.6 ft over its floor at the house wall to 6.5 at its outer edge.
The lanai is an open porch inside the main block's outline: walls of the house on two sides, open with a rail on the front, steps down at its north-west end.

Window and door positions are the middle of the opening between the posts drawn either side of it, measured to about +-0.2 ft; widths are between the posts. The north-west (sheet 'North elevation') side was checked against sheet 4: a pair of windows in each bedroom and one in the bathroom.
The shed is reached from outside only; whether its gap to the south-east is a doorway is not drawn (marked uncertain).
